title: Sealey Worksafe® Indirect-Vent Safety Goggles — Pack of 10
description_html:
Sealey Worksafe® Indirect-Vent Safety Goggles — Pack of 10

Reliable eye protection you can hand out across the whole team. This pack of ten Sealey Worksafe® goggles is ideal for workshops, grounds-care crews and busy garden-machinery workshops where several people need proper protection at once — from strimming and hedge-cutting to grinding and general maintenance.

Each goggle uses a clear polycarbonate lens for excellent impact resistance and unobstructed vision, while the indirect ventilation built into the frame keeps air moving and helps reduce fogging during longer jobs. The result is comfortable, dependable protection that people will actually keep on.

Certified to BS EN 166, optical class 1, impact grade B, so you can be confident they meet the standard for everyday industrial and horticultural use.

  • Clear polycarbonate safety lenses for high impact resistance and clear vision
  • Indirect frame ventilation to reduce misting during longer tasks
  • Certified to BS EN 166, optical class 1, impact grade B
  • Supplied as a pack of 10 — ideal for teams and shared workshops
